image_description: A modern interior staircase featuring a curved glass balustrade system. The primary visual element is a thick, light-colored wooden handrail that curves smoothly along the incline of the stairs. Instead of traditional vertical balusters, the railing is supported by large, transparent glass panels held in place by minimal metal clamps or channels. In the background, a perforated metal ceiling or soffit is visible, along with recessed lighting. The perspective looks up the staircase from a lower angle.
